launch
wait 12
shot 01-launch
tap (?i)choose a nickname
type Tester
sh input keyevent 111
tap (?i)^get started$
wait 4
swipeup
swipeup
taploop (?i)^(next|continue|get started|skip|allow|ok|accept|agree|got it|start|i agree|not now|later|maybe later|no thanks|done)$
tap (?i)^skip for now$
wait 4
adclose
wait 3
shot 02-after-onboarding
swipeup
swipeup
taploop (?i)^(next|continue|get started|skip|allow|ok|accept|agree|got it|start|i agree|not now|later|maybe later|no thanks|done)$
tap (?i)^skip for now$
wait 4
adclose
shot 03-main
sh su 0 sh -c 'for f in /data/anr/anr_*; do head -c 2000 $f; echo; grep -A40 "\"main\"" $f | head -60; done' | tee -a /tmp/amz-out/anr.txt
tap (?i)^wait$
wait 10
tap (?i)^messages$
wait 4
shot 04-messages
tap (?i)^ai$
wait 4
shot 05-ai
tap (?i)^settings$
wait 4
swipeup
swipeup
shot 06-settings-end
tap (?i)^talk$
wait 4
shot 07-no-talk-tab
back
